scenes.headline: How to fine-tune a model in only one context
scenes.sub: Train the output weights of a few neurons that fire there
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Burdock! A fine-tune for one behaviour usually changes a model everywhere. Here is a way to keep it in one kind of text.

scenes.text: A neuron writes its output column only where it fires, so editing the columns of neurons that fire only in the target context acts like an if statement.
scenes.say: A neuron writes its output column only where it fires. Edit the columns of neurons that fire only in your context, and the edit becomes an if statement.

parts.say: First, how strongly the neuron fires on this token.

scenes.say: Where the neuron is quiet, the product stays near zero.

scenes.title: How the neurons are chosen
scenes.say: The neurons are picked in three steps.

items.say: Keep neurons in the top ten percent of their layer on the target replies.
Drop any neuron whose activity on other text is more than a fifth of that.
Rank the rest by gradient per unit of activity elsewhere, and keep the top eight.

left.title: A LoRA
items: Edits weights every token passes through
Acts on code, maths, other languages
left.say: A LoRA edits weights every token passes through, so it also acts on code, maths and other languages.

right.title: Neuron tuning
items: Acts only where those neurons fire
right.say: Neuron tuning edits eight columns, so it acts only where those neurons fire.

scenes.title: Change on unrelated text at the same strength

steps.say: On a casual chat edit, selective neurons change unrelated text twelve to nineteen times less than a LoRA of the same size.
Neurons that fire everywhere go the other way, nine times more.

scenes.label: rank correlation of off-target write with change, 210 edits
scenes.say: Why it works: activity elsewhere, times the size of the update, orders the side effect across two hundred and ten edits.

scenes.label: Near questions that named the made-up tree
scenes.say: But a context is not a fact. On a small model, I taught one tree's name to eight neurons, and thirteen of sixteen other gardens got the same tree.

scenes.text: Locality comes from where the neurons fire, so other kinds of text stay put, but nearby prompts can still change.
scenes.say: Other kinds of text stay put. Nearby prompts can still change.
Pick quiet neurons, train only their columns, and test the nearby prompts.
